title: Customer Narrative Composer
objective: Convert the W7 whole-chart priorities, W8 professional topics and W9 professional timeline into a continuous customer-readable BaZi narrative without recalculating the chart, flattening contradictions or repeating one-symbol definitions across sections.
compositionRules: The opening synthesis must compress the chart into the first three priority themes rather than repeat a generic BaZi introduction.
Each priority chapter must add a different layer of meaning: relationship interface, pattern path, functional group, carrying structure or explicit timing activation.
Professional topic narratives may reuse source facts but must not repeat an identical narrative paragraph across life domains.
A selected timing window may extend the natal narrative but must not overwrite natal priorities or convert convergence into event certainty.
Customer-visible copy must not expose IR, work-package numbers, authority/admission vocabulary, semantic-owner vocabulary or production-state terminology.
Renderer code may select language and layout but may not invent new narrative meaning.
